title: DAL v0 safety and evidence contract
audience: Agents and maintainers changing feedback, policy, evaluation, approval, or controller-observation behavior

claims.text: Version 0 is local-only by default. Its fixed user-global installer and purpose-specific proposer/e2e paths independently verify exact approvals; no generic shared-configuration or network executor, plugin installer or mounter, optimizer runner, or candidate applier ships.
Deterministic schema, privacy, policy, provenance, budget, and quarantine checks may block but cannot authorize a sensitive action.
Shared configuration, plugin management, external transfer, and candidate application require a separate exact, current human approval at the execution boundary.
A passing offline scorecard is prerequisite evidence only; a hard stop quarantines or requests manual rollback and blocks proposal progression.

The tau-style benchmark separates harness and business outcomes, requires evaluator-owned effect evidence where declared, and permits full model batches only through the approval-bound Docker candidate/service/grader topology.
Controller estimation publishes deterministic observation-only state from one compatible task batch and pinned harness generation; insufficient evidence cannot invoke adaptation or grant authority.

retrieval_pointers.when: Changing persisted JSON fields or enum values
Deciding whether evidence, review, or approval may permit an action
Working near shared, external, plugin, or candidate-application behavior

limits: This capsule summarizes reviewed v0 contracts and does not replace schema validation.
It provides no dsh runtime, OS sandbox, optimizer, model, or external-service proof.
Validate source digests and freshness before using these claims.
